title: Potatoes – French Onion Lyonnaise
description: Food & Wine: This rich, comforting side marries the best of French onion soup and classic Lyonnaise potatoes for crispy, buttery rounds layered with caramelized onions, nutty Gruyère, and fragrant thyme.This recipe brings together the two French classics of French onion soup and Lyonnaise potatoes into one gloriously rich and satisfying side. French Onion Lyonnaise Potatoes are an ideal partner for roast chicken, steak, or a simple green salad. It’s a dish that feels both simple and luxurious, the kind of food that warms your kitchen as it fills the air with buttery, oniony aroma.
ingredients: 2 large sweet onions, thinly sliced lengthwise (about 5 1/2 cups)
1 1/2 pounds Yukon gold potatoes (about 4 medium), peeled and sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick rounds about 2 cups)
directions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium. Add onions and 1 teaspoon salt; reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep golden brown, 30 to 40 minutes. Add sherry; cook, stirring constantly and scraping any browned bits from bottom of skillet, until sherry is fully absorbed, about 1 minute. Transfer onions to a medium heatproof bowl; set aside. Rinse and wipe skillet clean.

While onions are cooking, place potatoes and 1 tablespoon salt in a medium saucepan, and fill with enough water to cover potatoes by 1 inch. Bring to a boil over high. Boil over high, undisturbed, until just tender when pierced with a fork, about 3 minutes. Drain well and transfer potatoes to a paper towel–lined baking sheet in a single layer. Pat dry and set aside until ready to use.

Line a separate large baking sheet with paper towels; set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons butter and 1/2 tablespoon oil in cleaned skillet over medium-high. Add half of the parcooked potatoes in a single layer; sprinkle with 3/4 teaspoon salt. Cook, undisturbed, until golden brown on bottom, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip and cook, undisturbed, until golden brown on second side, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer potatoes to prepared baking sheet to drain and wipe skillet clean. Repeat process once more with remaining 2 tablespoons butter, 1/2 tablespoon oil, half parcooked potatoes, and 3/4 teaspoon salt.

Return all browned potatoes to cleaned skillet. Add caramelized onions, black pepper, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt; stir until incorporated (it is fine if some onions are not completely dispersed).

Preheat oven to broil with rack about 6 inches from heat source. Sprinkle potato mixture evenly with Gruyère; broil potatoes until cheese has melted, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from oven, and sprinkle with thyme. Serve immediately.
